en.review.okta.okta.is.the.leading.identity: Okta is the leading identity and access management platform, providing secure authentication for employees, customers, and partners. Its cloud-native architecture and extensive integration ecosystem make it the de facto choice for enterprise IAM.
en.review.okta.threatinsight.uses.ai.to.det: ThreatInsight uses AI to detect and block credential-based attacks in real-time, while adaptive MFA adjusts authentication requirements based on risk signals. The platform's zero trust architecture helps organizations implement modern security frameworks.
en.review.okta.with.the.auth0.acquisition.o: With the Auth0 acquisition, Okta now offers comprehensive identity solutions for both workforce and customer identity use cases.
en.review.okta.sso.to.7000.pre-built.app: SSO to 7000+ pre-built app integrations with SAML and OIDC support.
en.review.okta.context-aware.multi-factor.a: Context-aware multi-factor authentication with risk-based step-up.
en.review.okta.ai-powered.detection.of.cred: AI-powered detection of credential stuffing and brute force attacks.
Automated user provisioning and deprovisioning across applications.
en.review.okta.centralized.identity.store.w: Centralized identity store with integration to AD, LDAP, and HR systems.
Enterprise pricing based on deployment scale and features:
en.review.okta.custom.pricing.based.on.orga: Custom pricing based on organization size
en.review.okta.okta.certifications.validate: Okta certifications validate skills in identity and access management (IAM), single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), and API integration. These credentials demonstrate expertise in modern cloud-based identity solutions.
en.review.okta.core.okta.platform.knowledge: Core Okta platform knowledge including SSO configuration, MFA deployment, and lifecycle management.
en.review.okta.advanced.administration.of.o: Advanced administration of Okta environments including user management, app integrations, and security policies.

ar.review.okta.with.the.auth0.acquisition.o: من خلال استحواذ Auth0، توفر Okta الآن حلولاً شاملة للهوية لحالات استخدام الموظفين والعملاء.

hi.review.okta.with.the.auth0.acquisition.o: Auth0 अधिग्रहण के साथ, Okta अब कर्मचारी और ग्राहक पहचान दोनों उपयोग मामलों के लिए व्यापक पहचान समाधान प्रदान करता है।
